title: The Woman with a Letter
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：picture　|　正文 402 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 picture 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: For eleven years my mother cleaned ① pictures in a gallery that nobody visited on Tuesdays, and she could tell you, without looking at the label, which of them had been painted in a bad year. She said a ② picture is the only thing in a building that changes while you are not watching it: varnish yellows, a face goes grey, and one day a portrait is a portrait of nobody at all. On Sundays she took us to the ③ pictures, which she liked because nobody there asked her anything about art.

The gallery closed on Mondays, and on Mondays she took us in through the back and let us stand in front of whatever we liked. My sister liked the smallest ④ picture in the building, a woman with a letter, which is not the ⑤ picture of grief at all, and which my mother said was worth more than the whole north wall. She said the ⑥ bigger picture — the money, the insurance and the men in the office — was not our business and never had been.

In 2009 a man came from a television company and asked to film her at work. She said no. He came back with a ⑦ picture of her taken through the window of the café opposite, and said it showed how much the gallery needed the money. He asked again and said he would put her ⑧ in the picture this time, that the film was really about the gallery's money, and that she was only in the background.

She said that being in the background of somebody else's picture is exactly how a person ends up being cleaned off it. I did not ⑨ get the picture until years later, when I read the file. The gallery was insured for eleven million, the north wall for nine, and the woman with a letter for nothing at all, because nobody had ever valued her. My mother had spent eleven years cleaning a picture that the building's own papers said did not exist.

She retired in 2011 and took up photography, which she says is easier because a photograph argues with you less. The ⑩ picture I had carried of her work — a woman alone with a brush in an empty room — turned out to be wrong in almost every particular: there had been eleven other cleaners, three unions, and a fight about gloves that lasted two years.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: C. n.[pl.] 电影；电影院（the pictures，英式）
D. 固定搭配：get the picture 明白；了解情况
E. 固定搭配：be / look the picture of ……的化身；显得非常……
F. 固定搭配：put sb. in the picture 把情况告知某人
G. 固定搭配：the bigger / broader picture 全局；大局
H. n. （心中的）形象；印象；描绘（form / carry a picture of ...）

items.q: She said a picture is the only thing in a building
she took us to the pictures
the smallest picture in the building
not the picture of grief at all
a picture of her taken through the window
put her in the picture this time
I did not get the picture until years later
The picture I had carried of her work

answers.why: pictures 复数意为“画作”，母亲在画廊里清理的就是这些画。
a picture 意为“一幅画”，说画是建筑物里唯一会在你不看时变化的东西。
the pictures 是英式说法，意为“电影院／电影”，说星期天她带我们去看电影。
the smallest picture 意为“最小的一幅画”，指画中拿信的女人。
the picture of grief 意为“悲伤的化身”，说这幅画完全不是悲伤的样子。
the bigger picture 意为“全局、大局”，指钱、保险和办公室里那些人的事。
a picture of her 意为“一张她的照片”，是从对面咖啡馆窗口拍到的。
put sb. in the picture 意为“把情况告知某人”，说这一次会把内情告诉她。
get the picture 意为“明白过来、了解情况”，我多年后读了档案才明白。
carry a picture of ... 意为“心中对……的形象／印象”，说我对她工作的想象几乎全错。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 我母亲在一座画廊里清理了十一年画作。（picture）
她说，画是建筑物里唯一会在你不看的时候发生变化的东西。（picture）
星期天她带我们去看电影。（the pictures）
那幅画完全不是悲伤的化身。（the picture of）
他说这一次会把内情告诉她。（put sb. in the picture）
多年以后我读了档案才明白过来。（get the picture）
answers: My mother cleaned pictures in a gallery for eleven years.
She said a picture is the only thing in a building that changes while you are not watching it.
On Sundays she took us to the pictures.
That picture is not the picture of grief at all.
He said he would put her in the picture this time.
I did not get the picture until years later, when I read the file.
